description: Header file declaring utility functions for handling vendor dlkm modules, including splitting ramdisk modules, writing filesystem configurations, repacking super images, building vbmeta and dlkm images, and moving files if changed. The functions support Android's vendor partition customization.
external_methods: Result<bool> WriteFsConfig(const char* output_path, const std::string& fs_root, const std::string& mount_point)
Result<void> RepackSuperWithPartition(const std::string& superimg_path, const std::string& image_path, const std::string& partition_name)
Result<void> BuildVbmetaImage(const std::string& vendor_dlkm_img, const std::string& vbmeta_path)
Result<void> BuildDlkmImage(const std::string& src_dir, const bool is_erofs, const std::string& partition_name, const std::string& output_image)
bool MoveIfChanged(const std::string& src, const std::string& dst)

methods.name: SplitRamdiskModules
